name: release-check
description: Release check for JACQUARD: tests and the gallery audit in parallel, then the web design review, then a build of every package.

branches.prompt: Run `pnpm typecheck`, then `pnpm test`, then `pnpm gallery --check`. Report each EXIT_CODE and every summary line.

Audit the example gallery in apps/web/public/gallery (index.json and each example file). For each example: call build_lift_plan with its design, weaves and the built-in profile named in setup.profile (with setup.repeatAcross), then check_floats; if there are violations, auto_fix and check_floats again; then build_cards and decode_cards on the final plan and compare. Check that each file says source standIn and that its recorded check.violationsAfter is 0 and matches what you found. Report findings in your usual format with a count per category.

steps.prompt: Review apps/web/src against .kiro/steering/design-language.md and the framing rules in .kiro/steering/product.md. Report only real problems with severity, in your usual format, with a count per category.
Run `pnpm -r build`. Report the EXIT_CODE and each package's build result line.
